values.note: Online bookings close 3 days before arrival; later arrivals take a first-come site and self-register at the office (cash or check). Payment is due for each tent or RV occupied by an adult.

note: Monroe County campground at Warrens on 50-acre Lake Wazeda, the county's first park (1958), with a swimming beach, fishing pier and boat launch. The walk-in tent sites sit on the lake below Castle Rock bluff. --Claude
